title: Catch an axolotl in a bucket

steps.title: Find a lush cave
steps.say: Axolotls swim in the water in [lush caves](biome:lush_caves). Look for green moss, glowing berries and an [azalea](item:azalea) tree above.

steps.title: Fill a bucket
steps.say: Make a [bucket](item:bucket) from 3 [iron ingots](item:iron_ingot), then fill it with water.

steps.title: Scoop it up
steps.say: Use the [water bucket](item:water_bucket) on the axolotl. Now it is in your [bucket](item:bucket).

steps.title: Bring it home
steps.say: Use the [bucket](item:bucket) where you want it to live, like a pond. It needs water, or it dries out.

steps.title: Feed it
steps.say: Axolotls eat [buckets of tropical fish](item:tropical_fish_bucket). Catch [tropical fish](mob:tropical_fish) the same way, with a [water bucket](item:water_bucket).

steps.title: Team up
steps.say: Axolotls fight [drowned](mob:drowned) and [guardians](mob:guardian) with you. A hurt axolotl plays dead to heal.
